title: Sentier mappings pair metadata
description: Identity file (metadata.json) carried by each data/<source>__<target>/ pair folder, listing its ordered package files.

source.description: Lower-kebab source datasource id, e.g. agribalyse-3.2.

target.description: Lower-kebab target datasource id, e.g. ecoinvent-3.9.1, ef-3.1, or a Sentier source.

target_proprietary.description: true ⇒ targets are opaque codes only (ecoinvent); false ⇒ full open identifiers.

packages.description: Ordered package files for this pair. Order is build order and precedence within the pair, never a global rank.

file.description: Package filename, e.g. biosphere.json or biosphere-1-curated.json.

order.description: Position in the packages list (1-based); for numbered filenames, equals the <n> in the filename.

entries.description: Number of entries in the package file. 0 is valid for a stub package whose file is not yet present.

title.description: Short label distinguishing this package from the pair's others.

generated_by.description: sentier-importers source name (or contribution note) that produced this package.

sidecars.description: Non-normative review/coverage files scoped to this package.
Non-normative review/coverage files scoped to the whole pair.
